text:
maria: Heads-up — after the CUDA driver bump last night we started seeing a regress in small-seq P50 and a KV prefetch hitrate drop. autotuner switched the prefetch stride and kernel pick for nvregion-2.

devon: saw it in perf dashboards too. small-seq latency +12ms P50, throughput down ~6% for 1-8 token requests.

jia: I pulled a trace from canary-32. autotune changed PREFETCH_STRIDE from 8 -> 1 during warmup; resulting in much more cache churn. snippet:
```
kv_prefetch_stride=1  // chosen by autotuner
prefetch_hits=4200
prefetch_misses=13000
kv_cache_evictions/sec=420
```

maria: exactly. kernel selector then favored the tight-smallseq kernel path which is cheaper in ideal cache hit cases but collapses with high miss rate.

samir: proposal: 1) roll back driver on affected fleet? risky. 2) quick toggle to force PREFETCH_STRIDE=8 for nvregion-2 canaries, ramp. 3) create an autotune-hotfix that biases cost metric by measured prefetch_miss_rate.

alyssa: +1 on non-driver rollback first. we can flip config via feature flag in ~5m and watch. add an emergency canary group with 5% traffic.

devon: ops-bot can patch config: `POST /api/v1/flags` payload: `{ "flag":"autotune.kv.prefetch_stride_bias", "value":"+8", "scope":"nvregion-2" }`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled flag flip to `autotune.kv.prefetch_stride_bias=+8` on nvregion-2 canary at 2198765500, will report metrics every 60s.

jia: added perf probe to the canary harness to capture kernel pick distribution, kv hit/miss, and sequence-length histogram. quick dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/kv-prefetch/2198765432

maria: if canary looks good at +5% traffic for 10m, we can rollout to nvregion-2 at 50% and then full. fallback plan: if P50 doesn't improve, revert flag and mark as driver-related and open driver rollback/downgrade RFC.

samir: also creating a short-lived canary that forces `kernel_selector.force_path=legacy-smallseq` so we can validate if kernel path alone explains regression.

devon: quick check — how hard is a forced kernel pick? we have a runtime knob `FORCE_KERNEL_PATH=legacy-smallseq` per pool.

alyssa: super easy, but that path costs ~3% more tokens normally. acceptable for 30m experi.

maria: timeline: flip prefetch_bias at 2198765500 -> monitor 10m -> if good, widen at 2198766120 -> finalize 2198767200. I'll own coordination with SRE for rollback windows.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary flag flipped at 2198765500 ✅  — monitoring started.

devon: early numbers (1m): prefetch_miss_rate down 45%, P50 small-seq improved ~9ms. good signal.

jia: kernel pick distribution also shifted back to hybrid path (expected). saving traces to gs://perf-traces/2198765432/ for postmortem.

maria: OK, ramp to 50% now. @samir stand by to abort if error rate spikes.

samir: standing by. if error_rate > 0.5% or latency regresses, abort.

alyssa: note for postmortem: autotuner should consider TTL for stride changes and a hysteresis on miss_rate before flipping.

maria: agree — action items: (maria) write rollback/runbook; (jia) add autotune metric guard; (devon) prepare driver downgrade steps as last resort; (samir) monitor canary and execute abort if needed.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: ramp to 50% completed at 2198766120. monitoring alerts hooked.

devon: all green so far at 50% for 6m. I'll start full rollout once 10m passes.

maria: great work — thanks team. we'll write a short postmortem and a small autotune guard patch to avoid immediate flips after driver upgrades. :thumbsup:
